prompt: Divide two ints and return the exact double quotient -- 7 divided by 2 must give 3.5, not 3.0. Cast before dividing.
explanation: When both operands of / are ints, Java performs integer division and discards the remainder, so 7 / 2 is 3 -- and casting that result to double just gives 3.0. Casting one operand first, (double) a / b, promotes the other operand automatically and makes the division itself a floating-point division. The cast must happen before the division, not after.
hints: 7 / 2 in int arithmetic is 3; the fraction is lost before any cast can save it.
(double) (a / b) is the classic mistake -- it casts the already-truncated result.
Write (double) a / b: the cast binds to a alone, so the division is done in double.
